[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Course schedule (cycle detection)** [LC 207 · Course Schedule](https://leetcode.com/problems/course-schedule/){difficulty="Medium"}

A directed graph has a cycle iff a DFS meets an edge to a vertex that is **still on the recursion stack** (a back edge). Meeting a vertex that is already **finished** is harmless: it is a second path to the same place, not a cycle.

[Solved in full in @sec-test-p2-courses.]{.card-link}

:::
